name: opencode-datalens-harness
description: OpenCode plugin: DataLens Platform harness. Registers the get_iam_token and get_harness_session_id tools natively, bootstraps the main_orchestration and sparkconnect skills and the engineer/scheduler subagents into ~/.config/opencode, writes mcp/permission/instructions into the global opencode.json (idempotent, fs + jsonc-parser), and bundles a spark-connect MCP server. Zero runtime hooks.
author: philippkozmin
